notes: No map location: unlocks when its prerequisites are met and the player teleports in (Journal → Ascension → Teleport; owner, 2026-10-14). Metabot gives no prerequisite field for Ascension quests (prereq-gates §5).

Gate verified by the owner 2026-10-15 (owner check 6a): it starts automatically when The Being Beneath the Lake is turned in, not before. It is the flight tutorial and rewards the item Ascension: Daeva; the first wings come from The Being Beneath the Lake. Ascension Gauge Level 1 tooltip (owner:2026-10-15-alt-26): needs Verdant Melody Complete, The One Who Hears the Voice (text cut off) and 100% gauge progress; gauge points come from Episode, Regional and Ascension quests, Sealed Dungeons and Strongholds (feeds E8 / check 6b; no gate change).
